Not dependency-ready (dep-gated, not extracted): P1.6c/d/e and P1.7a/b (after P1.6b/P1.6c — still [ ]/[~] in PLAN.md), P3.4 both bullets (gated on durable save/share acceptance and the feasibility check), P4.2 retroplanning (after P4.1 — the P4.1 section still has an open bullet), P4C.2 (literal deps P4C.1/P0.2 met BUT PLAN.md records "§10 open items still need product confirmation before P4C.2 starts" — D05), P4C.3/4/5, P5/P8 (execution-order item 4 gates on durable-persistence/reconnect evidence, unverified), P9 (domain safety), P10 (final regression).
